checks: The N=4 examples evaluate to [0,2,0,2] and [2,0,2,0], and both inverse checks are correct.
The half-open signed map gives k=4 -> -4 kHz for N=8, f_s=8 kHz and k=3 -> -6 kHz for N=6, f_s=12 kHz; the even-N Nyquist singleton is not duplicated.
For real input, X[(N-k) mod N]=X*[k], with DC and even-N Nyquist real; the odd-N endpoint rule is correct.
The phased cosine coefficients 4 exp(+j pi/3) and 4 exp(-j pi/3), and the composite raw coefficients 16, 12 exp(-j pi/4), 8, 12 exp(+j pi/4), are correct.

Normalization is consistent: raw-forward/1/N-inverse, forward-scaled/no-inverse-scale, and unitary pairs give 8, 1, and sqrt(8) for the alternating N=8 record; alpha beta N=1 and the scaled Parseval prefactor 1/(N|alpha|^2) are correct.

Circular-convolution examples independently reproduce [1,1,-2] versus [-1,1], [1,3,5,3] versus [4,3,5], and [2,5,1,-2] versus [0,5,1]; N >= L_x+L_h-1 is stated with the correct finite-array qualification.
The off-bin N=8 coefficients independently reproduce X[0]=X[4]=1, X[1]=1+j2.179580, X[2]=1-j2.613126, X[3]=1-j0.648847, and their conjugates.

The 173 Hz padding examples give errors 0.1875 and 0.0625 original bins at Q=1 and Q=4; the N=64 pair fails target-location stability and the N=256 pair has target peaks at 170 and 180 Hz for both declared phases.
The even/odd split uses W_8^{k+4}=-W_8^k and four-periodic E,O correctly, yielding X[k+4]=E[k]-W_8^k O[k].
